service: Hyper3D Rodin (hyper3d.ai), Business plan, through the hyper3d MCP server
prompt: A tall, chunky wizard's walking staff standing upright: a thick, slightly crooked dark brown wooden pole with knobbly bumps, its top curling around one big rounded pale icy-white crystal. The crystal is solid matte clay. Hand-sculpted matte modeling clay, stop-motion claymation style, chunky rounded forms. One single closed object, no base, no text, no logos.

files.model.fbx: Rodin's base_basic_pbr.fbx; its embedded diffuse map is the final one, and its normal, roughness and metallic maps are flat 1-pixel images (flat normal, roughness 0.85, not metallic), so the clay stays matte
files.glow.png: Rodin's emissive map: the crystal glows

credits: Rodin reports no cost per call; about 0.5 credit a generation (T81's measurement). T105's total is in Docs/tasks/T105.md.
note: Rodin also made an emissive map that covers only the crystal; it is the glow mask (glow.png).
